name: Siclaw
description: Read-only SRE copilot that runs structured, multi-phase investigations of infrastructure problems and remembers what it learns.
whatItDoes: Helps operations engineers diagnose incidents without letting the agent change anything in the environment. It keeps investigation memory and reusable skills so later sessions build on earlier findings.
howItWorks: A Node service drives a four-phase deep investigation workflow over read-only tools, with kubectl used when available. External tools are attached as MCP servers. It is reachable through a local web UI, chat channels or a terminal interface.

requirements.name: LLM provider key
requirements.description: Model credentials configured in the application
